//: The SPA catch-all deliberately excludes /assets via a negative lookahead. Client-side routing needs the catch-all, but it was also swallowing missing build assets: a tab left open across a deploy requests its old hashed chunk names, and answering those with index.html made the browser report "'text/html' is not a valid JavaScript MIME type" — it asked for a module and got HTML. Excluding /assets keeps a missing chunk a real 404, which is honest and is what the reload-on-stale-chunk handler in src/utils/staleChunkReload.ts detects. Note that a self-rewrite (/assets/(.*) -> /assets/$1) does NOT work for this: it is a no-op and the catch-all still applies.
